name: vertex-ai-proxy
description: A self-hosted, Gemini-API-compatible gateway for Google Vertex AI with prepaid API keys, rate limits and per-request billing
author: Abdelrhman Diab

scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @gateway/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:admin: pnpm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @gateway/admin run dev
scripts.admin:create-owner: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @gateway/api run build && dotenv -e .env -- node apps/api/dist/cli/create-owner.js
